# Installing the widget

The widget installs from the package registry with whichever package manager the project already uses, and it needs nothing else to get started on a new project.

**npm**

Run npm install widget in the project folder, which adds it to the dependencies.

**pnpm**

Run pnpm add widget in the project folder, which adds it to the dependencies.

Sites that tie their tabs to panels by position alone are read the same way, in the order that the tab strip gives them in the page's markup.

**Apple**

This is an apple.

**Orange**

This is an orange.

> Restart the dev server after installing, or the widget will not be found.

That is all it takes to install the widget, and the next page goes on to show how to configure it for the project that is going to be using it.
